items.period: Shuowen Jiezi Small Seal tradition; the page does not provide an excavated-artifact date
items.tradition: Small Seal style; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern rendering of 問 in Shuowen seal-script style. The received analysis assigns 口 a meaning role and 門 a sound role; this drawing does not establish a link to the disputed Shang graphs.
items.alt: A seal-script-style rendering of 問, presented as a modern vector image.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the depicted character and style, states reuse terms for the SVG, and the form illustrates the received Shuowen analysis discussed in the entry.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the Commons page for this SVG representation.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector redraw, not a photograph or direct reproduction of an excavated artifact. The identity and ancestry of the Shang 門-and-口 graphs remain disputed in the cited dossier evidence.
